verdicts.explanation: The homepage identifies the site only by the personal name 'Paul Graham' with no JSON-LD sameAs links, so an assistant has nothing to distinguish this Paul Graham from anyone else sharing the name.
Both crawled pages are real content pages (the homepage and a full essay) with no viewport meta tag, so mobile browsers will render them at desktop width and require pinch-zooming.
The homepage carries 3 images and none has an alt attribute, so a screen reader or non-visual consumer gets no description of any of them.

site_specific: Add a Person JSON-LD block to the homepage naming Paul Graham as the site's subject.
Include a sameAs array linking to his authoritative external profiles (for example his social media and Y Combinator profile pages) so assistants can disambiguate him from others sharing the name.

fixes.quote: New: How Universities Should Prepare Founders
site_specific: Add a viewport meta tag setting width to device-width and initial-scale to 1 in the head of the homepage and essay template.
Confirm the essay text reflows to the screen width instead of rendering at fixed desktop width on a phone.

fixes.quote: Want to start a startup? Get funded by Y Combinator .
site_specific: Add an alt attribute to each of the 3 images on the homepage describing what it shows.
Use an empty alt="" only for images that are purely decorative.
